sara: quick dump from the regional precision sweep. ran fp16/bf16/int8/fp8 w/ marlin-70b-ish on h100/a100/l4 across us-west/eu-central/ap-south. charts in the drive: https://redwood.test/drive/bench/2363456789 :chart_with_upwards_trend:

benchmark-bot: summary -> H100 (us-west): fp16 p50=45ms p99=210ms tokens/s=320 | int8 speedup~1.9x quality delta -0.6% ppl | fp8 speedup~2.1x quality delta -0.9%

benchmark-bot: summary -> A100 (eu-central): fp16 p50=58ms p99=300ms tokens/s=240 | int8 speedup~1.7x q-delta -0.5% | fp8 speedup~1.95x q-delta -1.2%

benchmark-bot: summary -> L4 (ap-south): fp16 p50=120ms p99=520ms tokens/s=90 | int8 not-supported (HW) | fp8 emulated tokens/s=110 q-delta -2.5%

tom: nice. can you paste the kernel flags & qprofile used? looking for batching/kv warmup differences.

chen: pasted snippets below:

```
MODEL=marlin-70b
KERNEL=fast_attn_v3
QPROFILE=per_channel_sym_4bit
BATCH=8
KV_WARMUP=enabled
QUANT_OPTS="--calib-n=1024 --clip-std=2.5"
```

chen: we ran per-shard quant with 3 seeds, eval set = 1k prompts (conversational + code), metric = mean-acceptance (human proxy) + perplexity.

maria: what was the mean-acceptance drop for int8/fp8 vs fp16? any catastrophic cases?

benchmark-bot: int8 mean-acceptance delta = -0.4% (±0.1) overall; fp8 = -1.05% (±0.3). failure modes concentrated on short-answer factuals and dates.

maria: ok that's within our threshold for *dedicated* tier but not for default hosted. we should consider routing fp8 -> dedicated only and enable conservative qprofile for hosted.

tom: agree. capacity sizing note: based on tokens/s numbers, 1 H100 pool (8x H100) can handle ~200k tps for fp16 at 99th util ~70%. with int8 we estimate ~380k tokens/s. rough math attached in chart.

sara: updated the runbook draft: suggested rollout plan -> canary on dedicated eu-central with int8 kernel fast_attn_v3, monitor mean-acceptance, p99 latency, and tail-OOMs for 24h. fallback to fp16 variant. I'll link the PR in a bit.

tom: any kernel regressions? did fast_attn_v3 behave differently between h100 and a100?

chen: small divergence: on A100 we saw a 4% higher p99 for fp8 vs H100, turns out kernel chooses a fallback path for attention >4096 tokens on A100. tracked in perf logs: `ATTN_FALLBACK=true` when seq_len>4096.

maria: action items:
- sara: open canary PR + add eval hooks (mean-acceptance)
- tom: add capacity calc snippet to the runbook
- chen: re-run fp8 with QClip=2.0 on a100 for the fallback path
- ops: hold 2 spare H100s for quick rollback

sara: noted. I'll tag ops and create the PR. thanks all :thumbsup:

tom: one last thing — add a tiny smoke test that runs the 20 most-failing prompts under the qprofile on each region before routing live. catches those date/factual regressions quickly.

sara: good call, adding to checklist now.
